note_text: Limit state 1 for tension can be omitted; only limit state 3 is checked (tension side limit is same or stricter than LS1)
Compression side checked at limit state 3, deemed not to exceed limit state 1
Combined bending+shear checked at limit state 1, deemed not to exceed limit state 3
Steel materials: SM520, SM490Y, SM400. Plates >40mm use constant yield point steel (except sole plates)
Flange width constant: upper 620mm, lower 680mm. Web thickness constant: 14mm
Flange plate thickness relief direction: upper flange downward, lower flange upward
Minimum plate thickness difference: 2mm (based on filler plate thickness). Max flange thickness difference: ≤1/2 of thicker plate (max 25mm)
Filler plate thickness: 2.3mm minimum, increments: 2.3, 3.2, 4.5, 6mm then 1mm steps
Allowable stress margin: approximately 5 N/mm²
Upper flange: fixed to concrete deck, no lateral buckling considered (local buckling only)
Lower flange: both lateral torsional buckling and local buckling considered
Composite stress check at web top and bottom edges (considers flange thickness via stress gradient from APOLLO program)
Horizontal stiffener: single stage, position based on reference girder height
Intermediate vertical stiffeners: basically divide panel points into 4 equal parts
Splice position: basically at center between vertical stiffeners (panel point divided into 4)
Field splice bolts: TCB M22(S10T). Inorganic zinc-rich paint coating considered
Splice plate area ≥ base material area. Bolt hole 24.5φ (25φ for tension tear-out check)
Upper flange splice plate: 50mm recess from flange edge (for composite slab clearance)
Lower flange splice plate: 5mm recess from flange edge
Fillet weld max 10mm (per Aichi 'Bridge Design Guide 3-33'). Over 10mm use partial penetration weld
Bearing stiffeners/crossbeam joints: fillet weld up to 12mm allowed for workability
Assumed vs actual stiffness ratio: ≤10% per panel point, ≤5% span average
Assumed vs actual steel weight ratio: ≤10% (per Aichi guideline 3-4)
Design program: APOLLO Super Designer (Yokogawa Technical Information)
Flange splice plates: ensure cross-sectional area and bending stiffness ≥ base material
Fillet weld: Inorganic zinc-rich paint coating considered; Vfk reduction factor α applied
Bolt arrangement dimensions: UFLG width 620mm with bolt gage lines at 140,90,90 spacing (75mm edge distance)
Dead load section determination is for out-of-plane bending moment calculation from transverse loads at mid-span and intermediate supports
Sole plate: material grade ≥ bearing shear key grade. >40mm: constant yield point steel NOT used
Fillet weld on all 4 sides of sole plate. Weld size ≥ √2t from sole plate center thickness
Level 2 seismic horizontal force from dynamic analysis used for weld verification
Shear key bearing check not required (verified at 175% shear strain for shear key in performance test)
Steel weight comparison: Actual (311.594t) / Assumed (325.566t) = 95.7% [OK] within 10% limit
When bending stress ≤45% of limit, weld size determined by shear stress only
Bolt design: needs both limit state 1 (slip) and limit state 3 (bolt fracture) checks
